title: HubSpot CRM Specialist for Luxury Flooring
systemName: Your HubSpot lead flow for in-home measures

facts: Post: HubSpot CRM specialist for a luxury hardwood flooring company. Manage lead flow, improve CRM processes, keep customer data organized and accurate, streamline outreach, improve follow-up, support customer communication.
No client name in the post and no reviews; personalization omitted (U-006).
HubSpot has no deck adapter; all scenes use the custom workbench workspace.

project.rooms: living room, dining room and hallway

scenes.title: One enquiry, routed to the right consultant.
scenes.caption: {{lead.name}} asks for an in-home measure. She already visited the showroom last spring, so she is matched, not duplicated.
scenes.beat: Claire fills in the measure request on your website. HubSpot finds her existing contact from her showroom visit, tidies her phone and project details, sees she wants an in-home measure, and assigns her to Marcus, the design consultant for her area. The showroom walk-in route stays idle for this one.
details: Matching uses email first, then phone, so a returning customer keeps one contact
Routing rules by enquiry type and area are agreed with your team
